snippet.title: Project MALLOW - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Project MALLOW - a hardcore, 2D puzzle-platformer from Aggressive Combustion Game Studios, coming to PC, iOS, and Android fall 2016!

For more information please visit aggressivecombustion.com
Follow us on Twitter @AC_GameStudios
